# Context Presets API Migration - 2026.04.27

## Summary of Changes

Migrated web context presets from deprecated `Context.get_VLTI()` / `Context.get_LIFE()` calls to `phise.examples.contexts` and added `PHOB` as an available preset across the Streamlit web pages and shared context widget.

## Files Modified

- `web/utils/context_widget.py`
- `web/pages/02_Projected_Telescope_Positions.py`
- `web/pages/08_Chip_Calibration.py`
- `web/pages/09_Spectral_Scan.py`
- `web/pages/10_Time_Modulation.py`
- `web/pages/11_Modulation_Spectrum.py`
- `web/pages/12_On_Sky_Contribution.py`
- `web/pages/13_Correlation_Map.py`
- `web/pages/14_Detection_Statistics.py`
- `web/pages/15_Distribution_Model.py`

## Technical Changes

- Added imports:
  - `from phise.examples import contexts as phise_contexts`
- Replaced deprecated static calls:
  - `Context.get_VLTI()` -> `phise_contexts.get_VLTI()`
  - `Context.get_LIFE()` -> `phise_contexts.get_LIFE()`
- Added PHOB preset in all relevant preset dictionaries:
  - `"PHOB": phise_contexts.get_PHOB()`
- Updated fallback/default preset creation in shared widget helpers to use `phise_contexts.get_VLTI()`.

## Validation Performed

- Searched web codebase for deprecated calls and confirmed no remaining matches:
  - `Context.get_VLTI(`
  - `Context.get_LIFE(`
- Ran diagnostics on all modified Python files with no reported errors.
- Confirmed PHOB preset is available in all updated web preset maps.

## Breaking Changes

- None expected in UI behavior besides the new available `PHOB` preset option.
- Preset initialization now follows PHISE current API location (`phise.examples.contexts`).
